title: docs/operations.md build line claims bare cargo build produces bro
wanted_capability: An accurate operations build instruction: the workspace has no default-members, so plain `cargo build --release` builds only the root blackbox package (blackboxd + blackbox); target/release/bro requires `cargo build --release -p bro-cli --bin bro`. docs/operations.md:72 claims the bare invocation yields {blackbox,blackboxd,bro}, which misleads downstream image builds packaging the CLI set.
fallback_used: Downstream Dockerfile invokes cargo build with explicit -p bro-cli --bin bro package selection.
